priorityList: Pre-combat: Buff Arcane Intellect and Mirror Image, then pre-cast Pyroblast.
Combustion Activation: Use Combustion while a hard-cast (Fireball, Scorch, or Pyroblast) is finishing or while Meteor is in flight.
Cooldowns: Use offensive Trinkets, Racials, and Potions during Combustion when at least 6 seconds of the buff remain.
Power Infusion: Request or use Power Infusion when Combustion is active with more than 6 seconds remaining.
Combustion - Meteor: Cast Meteor while Combustion is active; time it early in the window unless the Burnout talent is taken, in which case use it late.
Combustion - Hot Streak: Instantly consume Hot Streak procs with Pyroblast.
Combustion - Pyroclasm: Hard-cast Pyroblast if Pyroclasm is active and the cast will finish before Combustion ends.
Combustion - Generation: Use Scorch (standard) or Fireball to generate Heating Up, using Fire Blast to convert it into Hot Streak.
Filler - Hot Streak: Consume Hot Streak procs with Pyroblast immediately, especially during the Firestarter phase (target > 90% health).
Filler - Pyroclasm: Hard-cast Pyroblast if you have 2 stacks of Pyroclasm or if Combustion cooldown is longer than 12 seconds.
Filler - Meteor: Use Meteor outside of Combustion if Sunfury Execution is talented and Combustion is not about to come off cooldown.
Filler - Execute/Procs: Cast Scorch when Heat Shimmer procs or if the target is below 30% health with the Scald talent.
Filler - Main: Cast Fireball as your primary spell to generate Heating Up procs.
Fire Blast Weaving: Use Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak while a spell is currently being cast and you do not already have a Hot Streak proc.
